why: THE COMPASS ONLY EVER ASKED 'DID WE FIND THE EDGE'. compass-pairs.json is 55 positive representatives and reads 55/55, which an engine that joined EVERY pair would also score. These are the negative half: one representative per CLASS of false edge, keyed on the TAG the panel judged (not on a mechanism category, which is what the positive compass uses), chosen from the panel's 579 FALSE verdicts so each carries a judged argument rather than an invented one. The class names are the panel's own `cause` values.

pairs.why: Nulldrifter triggers on casting ITSELF, not on you casting a spell. The consumer does not care about the event it was credited with.
Leyline of Resonance triggers on casting an INSTANT OR SORCERY that targets a single creature you control. A creature spell never satisfies it.
pairs.source: panel verdict, owner-judged (blind agreement draw round 2, 2026-08-07)

pairs.why: Arjun triggers on ANY spell you cast, so pairing him with each of 60 spells is a mesh, not a synergy. The 2026-08-16 ruling: a deck role is not a pairwise edge.

Uthros pumps ITSELF: the corpus text reads 'This Spacecraft gets +1/+0 for each artifact you control'. Talisman is one of the artifacts COUNTED, but the buff lands on Uthros, so the consumer never receives the effect it was credited with. NOTE: the panel verdict this row came from says 'it pumps nothing', which the oracle text does not support -- the class label is the panel's, the reason here is read off the card.
SELF-REFERENCE ON BOTH SIDES. Incubation Druid's Adapt puts counters on ITSELF; Evolution Witness triggers on counters put on ITSELF. This is the family that was 74% of all false edges.

STILL CLAIMED on the shipped engine as of 2026-09-07. Yuna reads '...is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, IF IT HAD ONE OR MORE COUNTERS ON IT'. A sacrificed fetchland carries none, so the intervening-if is not being applied. — FIXED 2026-09-20 (AL4): the condition is a refusal when the producer IS the dying thing and cannot carry a counter. Banked here so a regression fails the compass.

Threaten STEALS a creature: you gain control. Only a control change an opponent gains feeds Zedruu's count of permanents you own that they control; the first #681 cut read every gains-control as yours and linked Insurrection and Dominus of Fealty.
Recoup gives flashback to ONE target sorcery card in your graveyard; a one-target grant is not a class of the deck (review of the spell-grant join).
Broodlord grants convoke only to spells cast FROM EXILE; a narrowing the subject cannot hold stays refused rather than widened to every spell (audit of the 39 spell grants).
Casualty 2 needs a creature with power 2 or greater; a 1-power creature cannot pay it.
The Eldest Reborn only ever gets lore counters; The Earth Crystal doubles +1/+1 counters on creatures.
Owner ruling 2026-09-27: flicker and reanimation spells are not tribal pieces, so there is no spell -> Inalla edge; the reuse scores the Wizards instead (#571).
A Treasure is a noncreature token: sacrificing it is not a creature dying, which is all Zulaport watches.
Owner ruling 2026-09-27: undying is fodder (it comes back once), not a death-payoff link of its own.
Pillage discards cards of unknown type; the fill is keyed `any`, never filed under instants.
Folk Hero's granted draw fires when you cast ANOTHER spell sharing the commander's type, once each turn; casting Nalia herself does not trigger it.
Hateful Eidolon draws only when an ENCHANTED creature dies; Doomwake's -1/-1 killing an unenchanted creature draws nothing.

knownDefects.why: STILL CLAIMED on the shipped engine as of 2026-09-07. Same pair as the false-care row above, under a different tag: the consumer's qualifier is not being read, so a broader cast tag still joins them.

context: MEASURED ON THE SHIPPED ENGINE (derived tags) IN PAIR ISOLATION. `eval-pairs` read the retired FLAT collection until 2026-09-07, which is why the compass reported 55/55 while its own CI gate reported 41/55 for the same set. Isolation remains: `pairReasons(a,b,hierarchy)` has no deck around it, and the product's `analyzeDeckStructured` adds deck-level passes. See roadmap Z4.
